Definition: near, with or among; often in general, to
BiblicalUsage: 1) to, toward, unto (of motion); 2) into (limit is actually entered); 2a) in among; 3) toward (of direction, not necessarily physical motion); 4) against (motion or direction of a hostile character); 5) in addition to, to; 6) concerning, in regard to, in reference to, on account of; 7) according to (rule or standard); 8) at, by, against (of one's presence); 9) in between, in within, to within, unto (idea of motion to)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
